hasil.skenario: Google OIDC discovery + authorize URL pakai GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID .env
hasil.raw:
issuer       = https://accounts.google.com
token        = https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token
jwks_uri     = https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/certs
client_id .env ada di authorize URL = True
PKCE S256    = True
CEK: client asli + PKCE -> True

hasil.skenario: Token exchange NYATA ke Google (client .env sah)
hasil.raw:
POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token -> HTTP 400
  {
  "error": "invalid_grant",
  "error_description": "Malformed auth code."
}
error = 'invalid_grant'
CEK: 'invalid_grant' (code dummy) bukan 'invalid_client' -> True

budi  groups=['katalir-owners'] -> role=owner
siti  groups=['katalir-dev']    -> role=developer
tono  groups=[]                 -> role=viewer (default)
CEK: pemetaan group->role tepat -> True

hasil.skenario: JIT provisioning: user dibuat otomatis saat login
hasil.raw:
get_user('budi@acme.test') -> {'email': 'budi@acme.test', 'name': 'Budi', 'org': 'acme', 'groups': ['katalir-owners'], 'provider': 'oidc', 'active': True, 'created_at': 1791502247.768214, 'updated_at': 1791502247.768214}
CEK: user ter-provision + org benar -> True

hasil.skenario: Sesi SSO tersimpan di backend NYATA
hasil.raw:
backend      = Redis VPS NYATA via SSH tunnel :56096
session_id   = _rctH9naUThg…
session.get  -> role=owner
CEK: sesi hidup & terbaca kembali -> True

detail.backend: Redis VPS NYATA via SSH tunnel :56096

hasil.skenario: Logout + Single Logout (matikan SEMUA sesi user)
hasil.raw:
slo('budi@acme.test') -> 2 sesi dimatikan
session(sid) setelah SLO -> None
CEK: semua sesi user mati -> True

dave@globex.test -> org=globex role=admin
org_for_email(budi@acme.test)   -> acme
org_for_email(dave@globex.test) -> globex
CEK: tenant tidak tercampur -> True

hasil.skenario: CSRF: state SEKALI pakai -> replay DITOLAK
hasil.raw:
state diterbitkan -> dipakai sekali -> OK
pakai ULANG state yang sama -> RAISES StateMismatch
CEK: anti-replay aktif -> True

token di ciphertext? False (harus False)
ciphertext = gAAAAABqyCeq-N61_96y1u7xdmKHGjzDxRr-jNFo… (140 char)
decrypt cocok? True
CEK: token tidak tersimpan polos -> True

hasil.skenario: RAW OUTPUT: authorize URL nyata (siap login browser)
hasil.raw:
https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?response_type=code&client_id=<GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID>&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A8123%2Fsso%2Fcallback&scope=openid+email+profile+groups&state=st-raw&nonce=NoDDWwVOVlvMYMRFCy6bxzx0Lwot3tqp&login_hint=budi%40acme.test&code_challenge=NoH75bOSiS5hdOx2cyekmpoW2h-Wqk82iUgzu5wdVWU&code_challenge_method=S256
CEK: URL OAuth 2.0 Google terbentuk lengkap -> True

hasil.skenario: Error handling: state salah + token exchange gagal
hasil.raw:
login(state='x', expect='y') -> RAISES StateMismatch
exchange_code('kode-palsu')  -> RAISES AuthFailed
CEK: galat terklasifikasi -> True

hasil.skenario: Security: client_secret TIDAK pernah masuk URL/log
hasil.raw:
client_secret di authorize URL? False (harus False)
client_secret di seluruh hasil tes? False (harus False)
PKCE S256 dipakai = True
CEK: tidak ada kebocoran rahasia -> True
